The magnetic pull is real but Scorpio's intensity suffocates Capricorn's reserved love language. Mercury facing Saturn's square in the 3rd House creates friction between Scorpio's cryptic communication and Capricorn's blunt honesty. These misunderstandings escalate fast in the 7th House. Saturn trining Scorpio's 10th House placements gives this couple extraordinary career synergy and financial growth — joint business ventures thrive. Saturn squaring Neptune however warns of a disillusionment crisis hitting around year seven. Secret tip: Scorpio must stop testing Capricorn's loyalty — Capricorn shows love through action never words. Comment your partner's sign below!
